title: View the contents of a text file in Terminal
summary: Use the `cat` command to display the contents of a text file directly in your Terminal window. This is useful for quickly checking what is inside a configuration file or script without opening a text editor.

aliases.text: как посмотреть содержимое файла в терминале

steps.explain: Run the `cat` command followed by the path to the file you want to view. The contents will print to the screen.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the text file you want to view.
